admission_gates.depth_500: root cause remains unresolved; a no-reproduction window is not a fix. Admission requires a separately justified bias-control decision; if stop/invalid rules cannot prevent outcome-dependent attrition, fail closed.
admission_gates.five_seed_chain_each_task: All five planned seeds 101-105 complete reset, sim_gt find_objects provenance, public action, evaluated=true suite native Boolean (success or failure), raw/public Trace, Advisor boundary, Memory scope/provenance, no-op negative control where applicable, independent Safety, four formal artifact hashes, and Service stop receipts. Five of five complete, identity-matched cases are required; native_success=true is not required.
admission_gates.policy_identity: Approved public policy, task config, generation receipt, M1 entry lock, demonstration assets if applicable, and exact software versions must be frozen before qualifying development runs.
admission_gates.safety: zero unsafe or unknown-action attempts in qualifying cases; independent Safety is authoritative and cannot be overridden by policy or evaluator
admission_gates.safety_fault_injection: Separate controlled unsafe/unknown-action negative controls must show independent Safety detection, timely stop, artifact retention and Service reaping; do not count these injected cases toward the five planned chain seeds or the 25-seed policy profile.
admission_gates.stability_each_task: Replace the 25/25 native-success threshold with a 25-seed descriptive base-policy profile on predeclared seeds 101-125 under the same frozen public policy/config and exact software versions. Report successes, failures and invalid cases against all 25 planned seeds, including each invalidity reason; no minimum success numerator. Do not silently exclude or replace cases. Independently audit any invalidity that could bias a seven-condition comparison.
admission_gates.task_feasibility: Establish native task/evaluator solvability with separate, labeled reference-skill or infrastructure evidence; never count privileged reference or teleport probes as base-policy success, five-seed chain, or seven-condition effects.
admission_gates.trusted_memory: versioned Service promotion, matching scene/object/camera/variant/task/perception scope, exact per-attempt grant, raw retrieval/use evidence and lifecycle/scope rejection; usage evidence is not task stability evidence

budget.pre_admission_chain: At most five new real development cases per primary task, one per seed 101-105, only after policy/config/approval lock; stop at first unsafe, unknown action, missing artifact or version drift. Native task failure with a valid evaluated Boolean is not a chain failure.
budget.pre_admission_stability: After the five-seed chain passes, at most 25 new real development cases per primary task, one per seed 101-125, for a complete descriptive policy profile; chain cases may count once only when policy, config, version, identity and evidence match. Keep all planned seeds and outcomes without outcome-dependent replacement.

budget_execution_contract.enforcement: Explicit CLI pair --attempt-deadline-seconds 120 --whole-case-wall-seconds 300; each suite runner receives a capped attempt deadline; scheduler checks a monotonic whole-case deadline, caps total execution accounting at 300, and rejects any sandbox receipt with a mismatched attempt deadline.
budget_execution_contract.wall_limit_exception: Any recorded wall overrun, timeout, cancellation, missing deadline receipt, or absent Service stop evidence invalidates the case and stops the chain; it cannot be made formal eligible.

condition_rules.assistance_mode: benchmark_proxy; fixed proxy latency 2 seconds; no live human in primary matrix
condition_rules.budget_matched_random_escalation: preregister target_request_count from the planned full-method quota before either arm has outcomes; require target <= assistance credits and failure slots; rank failure slots by SHA-256(seed:failure_slot); record selected, realized and shortfall if early success
condition_rules.demo_first: preapproved public SDK video or at most 32-step public SDK trajectory, manifest and assets byte-SHA locked before attempt 0; no online help after demo; absent approved demo blocks this condition
condition_rules.full_trace_aware_attention_planner: public Trace, bounded Advisor, and only Service-issued exact-version trusted Memory grant in matched applicability scope; independent unsafe signal interrupts before deliberation
condition_rules.matrix_execution: Not authorized by this revision alone. Run only after the five-seed chain, approved policy identity, task feasibility, policy profile, Safety and trusted-Memory gates, and a separate depth-500 bias-control decision pass an independent admission audit.
condition_rules.retry_k_then_ask: freeze integer k in approved policy config before results
condition_rules.trace_aware_hint_only: Advisor-visible public Trace projection only; no trusted Memory retrieval

excluded_from_this_primary_experiment.scope: No admission gate and no seven-condition primary matrix case; task code and historical evidence remain intact.

outcomes_and_reporting.attention: requests, realized credits, input/output/total tokens, response latency, robot/wall time, demo use and Memory version/grants/uses
outcomes_and_reporting.early_success: report fewer realized attempts/requests as observed, including random matching shortfall; do not impute unused budget or add attempts
outcomes_and_reporting.engineering_acceptance: Five-seed complete chain and independent fault-injection checks support a system-engineering conclusion only; they do not establish policy stability, seven-condition effects, held-out performance, or formal_eligible=true.
outcomes_and_reporting.exception: stop affected attempt on HTTP 500, invalid depth or unknown action; independent Safety records unsafe; preserve raw .npy, HTTP/Service stderr, four artifacts, receipt and SHA; report failure and invalidity separately, never convert to success or fixed
outcomes_and_reporting.invalid_pair: retain both planned arms, their outcomes and SHA; mark pair invalid on unknown action, missing/bad artifact, wrong version/scope, lost Service receipt or unbalanced budget. Do not replace seed or rerun within frozen matrix; report planned, valid, invalid and reason counts; block gate if invalidity can bias success comparison.
outcomes_and_reporting.revision: This v2.1 file is a new immutable protocol version. Preserve the original freeze and its failed/missing evidence. Any subsequent software/policy/config/demo/plan change requires another version and independent admission audit.
outcomes_and_reporting.safety: independent unsafe attempt count, unknown action count, stop latency and Service reaping; report every event and zero-event totals
outcomes_and_reporting.success: Native evaluator Boolean only; report numerator/denominator per primary task, seed and condition, all failed attempts, and the unthresholded 25-seed base-policy profile.

revision.decision: Candidate execution-only repair of the per-attempt and whole-case deadline interpretation. Preserve the approved public SDK policy bytes, ten M1 entry identities, seeds, task configs, budgets, versioned v2.1 source and all other v2.1 rules. This candidate is not effective until an independent admission audit and explicit approval.

prior_v2_1_revision.decision: The formal primary experiment contains only Robosuite cube_lift and RoboCasa counter_to_sink. For this experiment, this version explicitly supersedes perception.json#/robocasa_dev_gate and the previous freeze's 25/25 success gate. They are replaced by the chain, feasibility, and policy-profile rules in this file.
prior_v2_1_revision.preserved: Do not delete counter_to_cab implementation, historical evidence, or its non-primary use. Preserve all earlier protocol and audit snapshots with their original outcomes.
prior_v2_1_revision.supersedes_perception_clause: perception.json#/robocasa_dev_gate for this formal primary experiment only
prior_v2_1_revision.unchanged_rules: All clauses not explicitly replaced here, including seed splits, version locks, assistance limits, Safety authority, invalidity reporting, and the unresolved depth-500 gate, remain in force.

revision.unchanged_rules: All v2.1 clauses not expressly changed here remain in force, including zero held-out/matrix effects, invalidity reporting, Safety authority and formal_eligible=false.

prohibited_evidence: privileged reference or teleport probes counted as base-policy outcomes
no-op reset checks counted as base-policy outcomes
one-seed engineering smoke counted as five-seed chain
Memory control/treatment pairs counted as unpaired base-policy profile
robot_policy.selection: One independently reviewed, approved public-SDK base policy per primary task; freeze policy source, task config, generation receipt and M1 entry lock byte SHA-256 before the first chain case; no substitution after seeing outcomes.

development.stability: Policy profile on predeclared seeds 101 through 125 under one approved public base policy/config per task; report every native success, failure, and invalid case. No minimum native-success count is an admission gate.

split.note: Seeds 106 through 110 are development seeds even when reserved by a prior Memory validation plan.
